response.sql: WITH j AS (SELECT s.entrystat AS entrystat, e.ambictemp AS ambictemp, e.imgcount AS imgcount FROM scanenvironment e JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = e.zoneref) SELECT entrystat, AVG(ambictemp) AS avg_ambictemp, AVG(imgcount) AS avg_imgcount, AVG(imgcount) - (SELECT AVG(imgcount) FROM j) AS diff_from_overall_avg_imgcount FROM j GROUP BY entrystat
